# VestiaireCollective.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/vestiairecollective-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/vestiairecollective-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Vestiairecollective.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Vestiaire Collective for Fashion Product Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-vestiairecollective)
- **Code:** [`vestiairecollective.py`](vestiairecollective.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product pages](results/products.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Vestiairecollective product pages
- Vestiairecollective search pages

## Functions

- `scrape_products(urls)` → `dict`: scrape vestiairecollective.com product pages for product data
- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import vestiairecollective


async def main():
    search = await vestiairecollective.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.vestiairecollective.com/search/?q=louis+vuitton",
        max_pages=2,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/products.json`](results/products.json): `id`, `type`, `name`, `price`, `description`, `path`, `sold`, `reserved`, `inStock`, `available`, `receipt`, `consignment`, `shouldBeGone`, `likeCount`, `measurementFormatted`, `isLocal`, `dutyAndTax`, `buyerFees`, `alternateVersions`, `metadata`, `indexation`, `flags`, `brand`, `size`, `color`, `material`, `condition`, `universe`, `category`, `subcategory`, `model`, `pictures`, `warehouse`, `pricingBreakdown`, `meshLinks`, `seller`, `prohibited`, `localizedDescription`, `originalDescription`, `originalDescriptionLanguage`, … (3 more)
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `brand`, `name`, `description`, `country`, `discount`, `colors`, `localEligible`, `directShippingEligible`, `editorPicks`, `likes`, `link`, `model`, `pictures`, `price`, `seller`, `sold`, `stock`, `shouldBeGone`, `createdAt`, `universeId`, `dutyFree`, `personalizationType`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`vestiairecollective.py`](vestiairecollective.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/vestiairecollective-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
